dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual parabolic narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth and symmetrical lateral margins with no observed asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median normalized pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey mottling distributed across the dorsal plane, particularly visible around the blowhole and mid-section.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light grey pigmented areas and the lighter baseline skin tone.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized reddish-purple chromaticity visible within the blowhole aperture and surrounding rim.
